_doc: Schema for site-pack/topology/bgp-rr-map.json — cp to topology/bgp-rr-map.json and replace the fictional entries with your own BGP route reflectors. One entry per RR: key = the RR router's identity name, ip = its loopback/management IP, network = the fiber network it serves (matched case-insensitively against the --network argument of scripts/temp_bgp_peering.py), verified_on = the IP you confirmed it on. Add new RRs here as you verify them live (/routing/bgp/connection print). All values below are fictional.
